subject: Digital signature exception & signer delegation for portal registration
messages:
From: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.ai>
To: Kevin Bradley <kevin.bradley@greenwayhealth.com>, Lisa Kim <lisa.kim@greenwayhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 7 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Digital signature exception & signer delegation for portal registration

Hi Kevin / Lisa —

Quick note to surface a small wrinkle as we finish vendor registration in Ariba: Greenway’s portal onboarding requires the company signatory to match the user who completes the profile in some flows, but your legal team has been asking that a delegated finance approver (not the executive signer) may complete portal steps. To avoid a block we want to get a documented delegation path and a narrow signature exception in the MSA so the portal can be provisioned without holding up PO acceptance.

Attached: MSA_Greenway_redline_v2.docx (our current redlines), OrderForm_PO_Field_Specs.xlsx, signature_matrix.pdf

Can you confirm who will sign the MSA and whether finance can finish the portal user setup? If helpful, we can propose a one-paragraph amendment allowing an authorized agent to bind for portal onboarding and PO acknowledgements (explicitly for EDI/portal flows).

I’ve looped in Marissa and Mateo from Legal & Ops to coordinate the wording and where to place the DocuSign envelope. Looking for a quick confirmation today so we don’t lose the Ariba provisioning window.

Thanks —
Diego
Director, Customer Onboarding
Redwood Inference
Attachment: MSA_Greenway_redline_v2.docx (document), OrderForm_PO_Field_Specs.xlsx (spreadsheet), signature_matrix.pdf (pdf)

From: Kevin Bradley <kevin.bradley@greenwayhealth.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.ai>
Cc: Lisa Kim <lisa.kim@greenwayhealth.com>
Date: Tue, 7 Sep 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Digital signature exception & signer delegation for portal registration

Diego —

Thanks for the heads up. We can do a delegation but need to confirm two things before approving: 1) The scope of delegation (is it only portal provisioning and PO acknowledge or does it include contract amendment signing?), and 2) PO acceptance fields we require be exact in Ariba (PO number formatting, remit-to details, and tax id).

Suggested flow from our side: CFO or GC executes the MSA; Procurement configures the portal via an authorized user (procurement@greenwayhealth.com). If the amendment is narrow (portal + PO ack) that should be acceptable.

Can Marissa/Kimberly review and send proposed wording and we’ll route for internal sign-off.

-Kevin
Senior Manager, Procurement
Greenway Health

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai>
Cc: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 8 Sep 2026 08:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Digital signature exception & signer delegation for portal registration

Kimberly / Mateo —

Forwarding Kevin’s note. They want a narrow delegation limited to portal provisioning and PO acknowledgements (not full amendment authority). Please draft a short clause we can insert as an order-form exhibit or schedule that: (a) clarifies an "Authorized Procurement Agent" may perform portal onboarding steps and accept purchase orders on behalf of Greenway solely for purposes of integration and PO acknowledgment; (b) excludes the agent from signing contract amendments or increasing financial commitments; and (c) requires the agent to be listed in the signature matrix and provide corporate ID when provisioning.

Also confirm whether we prefer the clause in the MSA body or as an Order Form exhibit (opinion: exhibit is faster operationally). I’ve attached the current redline and signature matrix again.

-Marissa
Sr. Counsel, Contracts
Redwood Inference
Attachment: MSA_Greenway_redline_v2.docx, signature_matrix.pdf

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.ai>, Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 9 Sep 2026 10:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Digital signature exception & signer delegation for portal registration

Marissa / team —

Thanks — we can accept the narrow delegation. Draft language below that I recommend adding as an "Order Form Exhibit: Authorized Procurement Agent" (clean + redline attached):

--- DRAFT CLAUSE ---
"For the limited purpose of onboarding, provisioning, and purchase order acknowledgement within Customer’s procurement portal (including but not limited to Ariba and Coupa), Customer may designate in writing one or more Authorized Procurement Agents. Such Authorized Procurement Agents are authorized to complete portal registration steps and to accept Purchase Orders on Customer’s behalf solely for the purposes of operational integration and order acknowledgment. An Authorized Procurement Agent shall not have authority to execute amendments to this Agreement, increase Customer’s financial commitments, or modify pricing or scope. Customer shall maintain an up-to-date signature matrix listing authorized agents and shall provide corporate identification upon request."
--- end draft ---

I attached MSA_Greenway_redline_v3.docx with the exhibit inserted as an Order Form Exhibit. Next steps: 1) Diego to confirm operational contact(s) for the portal (procurement@greenwayhealth.com?) 2) Legal send the DocuSign envelope for the MSA + Exhibit (we will restrict signature authority to GC/CFO for the primary execution and mark the Exhibit as acceptable for the named agent to perform portal tasks).

DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/greenway/msaredline/12345
Attachment: MSA_Greenway_redline_v3.docx

-Kimberly
Senior Counsel, Legal
Redwood Inference

From: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.ai>
To: Kevin Bradley <kevin.bradley@greenwayhealth.com>
Cc: Lisa Kim <lisa.kim@greenwayhealth.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 9 Sep 2026 15:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Digital signature exception & signer delegation for portal registration

Kevin / Lisa —

Thanks — we’ve inserted the agreed exhibit into the MSA and sent the DocuSign envelope to your GC/CFO for execution. Please have the signatory complete the DocuSign packet and, if possible, list procurement@greenwayhealth.com as the Authorized Procurement Agent in the signature matrix. Once signed, upload the executed MSA to the Ariba supplier record and we’ll finish field mapping for PO acceptance.

Key PO field reminders (from our Ops team): PO number must be 10-digit numeric; remit-to address must match tax_id on the MSA; EDI ACK window should be set to 24 hours. See attached OrderForm_PO_Field_Specs.xlsx for the exact mapping.

If you want, Mateo can do a 20-minute handoff call with your procurement admin to confirm the portal fields and user provisioning. Proposed times: Fri 11am or Mon 2pm PT.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — will monitor for the signed envelope.

Best —
Diego
Director, Customer Onboarding
Redwood Inference
Attachment: OrderForm_PO_Field_Specs.xlsx
